newsitem.title: UK: Unilever shares gain after Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares gain after Q3 results.

text.p: Shares in Unilever Plc rose in early trading Thursday after the Anglo-Dutch foods and consumer products group posted better-than-expected third-quarter results.
The stock was up 17-1/2p at 12.92-1/2 by 0814 GMT, rebounding from the two-month closing low of 12.73-1/2 set November 6.
Unilever said pre-tax profit before exceptional items rose six percent to 918 million stg in the third quarter. After one- off charges, pre-tax profit was up 5 percent at 826 million stg.
Analyst forecasts had been in a range between 760 million stg and 820 million.
The dividend was raised 46 percent to 10.29p, reflecting a rebalancing exercise, and was in line with expectations.

The company said its European ice-cream market share remained strong despite the impact of a poor summer on sales and profits, while frozen foods, detergents, personal products and speciality chemicals recorded improved profits.
"We thought there were good numbers and we are saying 'buy the stock'," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage. "They were good for another 20p on the shares."
